verdict.rationale: Porkbun's API documentation offers CRUD over DNSSEC DS records, so DS records can be managed at the registry programmatically. The pack does not show that Porkbun signs zones itself on its nameservers, or that there is a one-click dashboard toggle. Only DS-record handling, one half of the story, is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of one-click or automatic DNSSEC zone signing on Porkbun nameservers, a documented DNSSEC setup guide or UI flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
